main_text.p: dem ad veros Israelitas devolvenda esse, & ad veros Naturæ magos, qui ut olim Christo sic eidem nunc in suis fidelibus profugituro in Ægyptum, aperturi sint thesauros suos, quæ certè me impulit causa, ut ista mihi putarem pervestigan-da unde tamen ista peculiaris Theophra-sto futurorum denunciatio? unde, & a quo spiritu profecta Personalis nescio cujus Heliæ post ipsum venturi designatio? An ut in prognostico Theologico Adamus Nachemoser (ita sonat inscriptio) reformatorem quendam, quem mundi septimum ille numerat: part 4. lib. 4. cap 6. ab anno 1580. certò & sine exceptione spiritum Heliæ gestaturum asseverat: ita quoque consimiliter suum Heliam Chymicarum artium, & naturæ magistrum nobis prædicit Theophrastus, naturaline sagacia, & apprehensione mentis (præsertim pulvere lapidis & tinctura physicæ perpurgatæ) an prognosticatione quadam syderali & influentia cœlestisan peculiari afflatu, nescio quo, cu-jus

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left edge are cut off and only partly visible; not legible enough to transcribe. The underlined words in the text (anno 1580, spiritum Heliæ, quoque consimiliter, naturæ magistrum) are rendered as printed. The "san" in "cœlestisan" is a line-end reading of "cœlestis an" and is uncertain. The "Ioan. 3." line is not actually visible on this page and should be disregarded.
